landing.metaDescription: Drosi — manage courses, lessons, students, enrollments, quizzes, and files from a single trusted platform built for educators.

hero.title: Teach, learn, and grow — all in one place
hero.subtitle: Manage courses, lessons, students, enrollments, quizzes, and files from a single trusted platform built for educators.

features.heading: Everything you need to run your classes
features.subtitle: A complete toolkit for teachers and students, designed for clarity and focus.

courses.title: Courses & lessons
courses.description: Organize your curriculum with structured courses, rich lesson content, and publish when you're ready.

students.title: Students & enrollments
students.description: Invite learners, track enrollments, and keep every class roster up to date.

quizzes.title: Quizzes & assessments
quizzes.description: Create quizzes, collect attempts, and measure progress with built-in assessment tools.

files.title: Files & resources
files.description: Share materials securely with students through an integrated file manager.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.subtitle: Sign in to access your dashboard and continue where you left off.

howItWorks.heading: Get started in 3 simple steps
howItWorks.subtitle: From creating an account to your first lesson, the whole journey is fast and clear.

step1.title: Create your account
step1.description: Fill in your basic details and choose your role as a teacher or center admin in under two minutes.

step2.title: Set up your courses
step2.description: Add lessons, files, and quizzes, and organize them the way that fits your students best.

step3.title: Invite your students
step3.description: Share your invite link and track enrollments, attendance, and progress as they happen.

testimonials.heading: Teachers and students trust Drosi
testimonials.subtitle: Real experiences from educational centers using the platform every day.

items.quote: From the first week, we saved a huge amount of time tracking enrollments and grades instead of paper and spreadsheets.
items.name: Mariam Hassan

items.quote: A simple, fast interface — my students find everything they need, lessons and files, in one place.
items.name: Kareem Abdallah

items.quote: Online quizzes made things so much easier — I can now track every student's level accurately and quickly.
items.name: Sara Youssef

showcase.heading: Every detail of your educational center, in one place
showcase.subtitle: From attendance and grades to payments and schedules, everything is organized and easy to reach.
showcase.point1: A complete dashboard for every role
showcase.point2: Real-time reports and analytics on student performance
showcase.point3: Instant notifications for every important event

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Reach out and we'll help.

items.question: Is the platform suitable for small and large centers?
items.answer: Yes, Drosi is designed to scale with you, from a single teacher to a center with dozens of teachers and thousands of students.

items.question: Is my students' data and files secure?
items.answer: All data is encrypted and protected with precise role-based permissions, visible only to those authorized.

items.question: Can I use the platform from my phone?
items.answer: Absolutely, Drosi runs smoothly in the browser on any mobile device, tablet, or computer.
